name: QiuQiu
description: QiuQiu is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.

history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: Indonesia (game played throughout Indonesia); roots in Cantonese Pai Gow (China).
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: Indonesian domino gambling game related to Cantonese Pai Gow; name Qiu/Kiu from Chinese word for 9.
Cultural Significance: Popular in Indonesia; also known as Kiu Kiu.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
